lines.text: Health systems, surveys, spreadsheets, databases... and none of them talk to each other.
So your team spends weeks copying, cleaning and re-exporting, instead of making decisions.
Meet Open Hexa. The open-source data platform that brings it all together.
Connect your sources and automate pipelines, from ready-made templates, your own Python, or with the built-in AI assistant.
Every database, dataset and file lives in one secure workspace, shared on your terms.
Then turn it into dashboards, reports and web apps... with just a prompt.
Trusted by the World Health Organization, the World Bank, and health programs around the world.
Open Hexa. Turn your data into products your teams actually use.
